events.title: 100,000 wishlists!!!
events.summary: Arghhhh! Why are there so many raccoons on my porch? Hang on a second, let me count. 1… 2… 100,000?! (Must be a gigantic porch.) Gang! We are blown away to share that, in just about two weeks after it was announced, Dumpster Gang has already hit 100,000 wishlists on Steam! We are truly honored that so many of you are excited for what we’re creating and could not be more touched by all the kind words.
